copy_source_customer.transaction_contract: Root opens actual app READ COMMITTED transaction, captures login/pid/xid before business locks, issuer independently commits fresh handle hash + exact finite caps, then app binds handle. SQL contains neither handle nor issuer writes. Failure requires client/backend closure before independent observer; never treat command count as a commit proof.
copy_source_customer.diagnostic_limit: For P0002 require source-bound customer_atomic frame; state alone does not identify missing history/evidence. Unlisted diagnostics stop. 23505 proves native duplicate rejection only, not a production semantic-idempotency adapter.

Non-READ-COMMITTED context fails, without exposing a raw grant row.
Actor IDs, copied hash/GUC values, wrong purpose/root/field and malformed grants cannot manufacture authority.
Canonical query/pure/result/presentation and projection/history/access-evidence source scopes admit only SELECT

scope_limits: Read fixtures establish existing rows, not owner creation/publisher/legal policy or application API readiness.
Only exact finite registered nonmutating purposes; no general SH003 or invented no-result codec.
Worker catalog rights are issuer-authorized finite fields under registered default-Free work scope, not evidence of a lease/enrollment loop or hidden work-to-catalog FK check.
Consent related reads require exact capability edges; no claim that SELECT itself validates physical FK relationships when an issuer explicitly authorizes a foreign edge.
Consent positive proof/publisher/rendering vectors and all unavailable write/owner paths remain NOT_RUN.
Privacy completion denial qualifies only the named0A000 gate; blocked positive and full Privacy/restore paths remain NOT_RUN.
All selected cases/assertions remain NOT_RUN until independent actual evidence mapping.
